create_binary_shared_tensor: create a BinarySharedTensor from a plaintext tensor using XOR-based secret sharing across MPC parties
generate_przs_sharing: generate a Pseudo-random Sharing of Zero tensor using the PRZS static method for MPC protocols
perform_bitwise_xor_and: perform secure bitwise XOR and AND operations on BinarySharedTensor shares using beaver triples
reveal_binary_tensor: reveal the plaintext value of a BinarySharedTensor by performing a distributed BXOR reduce across all parties
compare_binary_tensors: compare two BinarySharedTensors using secure MPC circuits for equality, less than, and greater than operations
